text: A walkthrough of where Circle's products live in the Rialto codebase.
Arc, U S D C and E U R C are constants. U S D C is Arc's native gas token: eighteen decimals natively, six through E R C twenty.
Six contracts on Arc testnet, source verified, pointed at the live U S D C and E U R C.
The pool holds U S D C as token zero, E U R C as token one, and reads the oracle's rate.
Scaled prices E U R C in U S D C at the oracle rate, so the curve centres on the real price, not on one.
Every fee splits in code: half to L Ps, half to the protocol. Twelve and a half basis points.
The oracle: publishers sign E I P seven twelve attestations; submit recovers each signer, checks quorum, and refuses prints outside the cap.
Get rate takes the caller's own staleness bound and reverts past it.
Settlement: an instruction denominated in what the payee receives, with the invoice reference on chain.
Swap exact out delivers exactly that amount to the payee, and invoice settled records the reference and the rate.
This script settled the testnet invoice: the payer approves U S D C, calls settle, and the pool pays E U R C to the payee.
The publisher runs every ten minutes on Netlify: fetch the E C B print, sign it, pay gas in U S D C, submit.
Not in the code yet, and said so: C C T P version two and Gateway, Circle Wallets, partner stablecoins as they ship.
